items.raw_excerpt: Norway is known for being expensive, but this expression is for when something is beyond a bit pricey.
items.summary_en: Koste skjorta is a Norwegian saying for something that is more than a little pricey. Norway is known for being expensive, but this phrase marks a cost that is clearly too much.
items.summary_ko: 코스테 스요르타는 살짝 비싼 정도를 넘어 꽤 비싸다는 뜻의 노르웨이 표현이다. 노르웨이는 비싼 나라로 유명하지만, 이 표현은 확실히 돈이 많이 드는 경우를 가리킨다.
items.title_en: Norwegian Expression of the Day: Koste Skjorta
items.title_ko: 노르웨이 표현 하나: 코스테 스요르타
items.title_original: Norwegian expression of the day: Koste skjorta

items.raw_excerpt: The Socceroos kick off a two-game international friendly series against five-time world champions Brazil in Townsville. Follow live.
items.summary_en: The Socceroos play Brazil, the five-time world champions, in a friendly match in Townsville. Many Brazil fans have travelled to the northern city to watch. The game is the first of two friendlies.
items.summary_ko: 소세로스 대표팀이 5회 세계 챔피언 브라질을 상대로 친전 경기를 치르기 위해 호주 타운스빌에 도착했습니다. 많은 브라질 팬들이 경기를 보러 이 북쪽 도시를 찾아왔습니다. 이 경기는 두 경기로 진행되는 친전 일정의 첫 번째 경기입니다.
items.title_en: Brazil fans fill Townsville for Socceroos friendly

items.summary_en: This weekly horoscope looks at work, money and love for the week ahead. It is written by Guru, a well known fortune teller for Bangkok Post. Read on to see how your week may turn out.

items.raw_excerpt: RAF is heading to Ulundi, rural KZN in a bid to take services closer to the people
items.summary_en: The South African Air Force is flying to Ulundi, a rural town in KwaZulu-Natal. The team wants to bring its services closer to people who live far from them. This is part of an outreach programme for rural communities.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카 공군이 쿠아줄루나탈 농촌 지역 울룬디로 출격한다. 이들은 가까운 곳에서 생활하는 사람들에게 더 나은 서비스를 제공하기 위해 움직인다. 이는 농촌 지역을 위한 outreach 프로그램의 일부다.
items.title_en: RAF Visits Rural KZN to Bring Services Closer to People
items.title_ko: 국군 공군, 쿠아줄루나탈 농촌 지역으로 outreach 프로그램 확대
items.title_original: RAF drives outreach programme to rural communities in KZN

items.raw_excerpt: Millions of passengers in Germany are facing higher public transport costs in 2027. Berlin, Munich and Hamburg have already announced fare changes, with at least one region holding prices steady.
items.summary_en: Millions of Germans will pay more for trains and buses in 2027. Berlin, Munich and Hamburg have already announced higher fares. Some areas are keeping prices the same.
items.summary_ko: 2027년부터 독일에서 기차와 버스를 타는 사람들이 더 많은 요금을 낸다. 베를린, 뮌헨, 함부르크는 이미 요금 인상을 발표했다. 다만 몇 지역은 가격을 그대로 유지하기로 했다.
items.title_en: German Transport Fares Rise in 2027
items.title_ko: 독일 대중교통 요금 2027년 인상
items.title_original: Where are public transport fares set to rise in Germany in 2027?

items.raw_excerpt: Business leaders are hearing more about AI than ever. The hard part is deciding where it belongs in their company, which task to tackle first, and how to avoid spending money on tools that never become part of daily work.
items.summary_en: A business forum called LEDEX will be held in the town of Olhao in southern Portugal. Business leaders will talk about where AI fits in their company and which task to start with. They also want to learn how to avoid paying for tools that never become part of daily work.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 남부 알가르브 지역 올하이앙에서 LEDEX 포럼이 열린다. 지역 기업 leaders… sorry, 지역 기업 리더들이 AI를 회사 어디에 넣을지, 무엇부터 시작할지 논의한다. 매일 실제로 쓰게 되지 않는 도구에 돈을 쓰는 일을 막는 방법도 함께 다룬다.
items.title_en: AI Business Forum LEDEX Comes to Olhao in Portugal's South
items.title_ko: LEDEX 포럼 남부 포르투갈 올하이앙에서 개최
items.title_original: From AI Noise to Better Business Decisions: LEDEX Forum Comes to Olhão

items.raw_excerpt: A new civil society organisation has been formed to preserve the legacy of the NIC
items.summary_en: A new civil society group has been set up in South Africa. It wants to protect the memory and the work of the NIC. The group plans talks and small events so people can learn about the NIC past.

items.raw_excerpt: Diners have taken to social media to share photos of overly-shiny sandwiches and circular shrimp, lamenting the suspected use of AI. But some in the restaurant business say it's helped them reduce costs and save time in a notoriously difficult industry.
items.summary_en: Diners post photos of shiny sandwiches and round shrimp online. They suspect the pictures were made by AI. Some restaurant owners say the fake food photos help them save money and time.
items.summary_ko: 손님들이 번들거리는 샌드위치와 동그란 새우 사진을 SNS에 올리고 있다. AI로 만든 사진이 아니냐는 추측이다. 일부 식당 주인은 이런 가짜 음식 사진이 비용과 시간을 아껴 준다고 말했다.
items.title_en: AI Food Photos Are Flooding Restaurant Menus
items.title_ko: 식당 메뉴를 AI 가짜 음식 사진이 장악하다
items.title_original: AI 'slop' is dominating menus, as some restaurant owners turn to it to save time and money

items.raw_excerpt: Malaysia has approved imports of breeding pigs and pig semen from Taiwan, becoming a new export market following Hong Kong, Vietnam and Palau, the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Agency under the Ministry of Agriculture (MOA) said Friday.
items.summary_en: Malaysia has approved imports of breeding pigs and pig semen from Taiwan. The decision makes Malaysia a new export market for Taiwan, after Hong Kong, Vietnam and Palau.
items.summary_ko: 마레이시아가 대만산 번식용 돼지 가축과 정액액 정액의...

items.title_ko: 대만 돼지, 마레이시아 수입 승인
items.title_original: Taiwan-bred breeding pigs, pig semen approved for export to Malaysia

items.raw_excerpt: The 23-year-old broke her own national record - set just days earlier - by more than three seconds.
items.summary_en: Singapore swimmer Gan Ching Hwee, 23, won silver in the 800m freestyle at the Asian Games in Japan. It is her third medal at these Games. She broke her own national record by more than three seconds.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 수영 선수 간칭웨이는 일본에서 열린 아시안게임 800미터 자유형에서 은메달을 땄습니다. 23살 그녀에게 이번 대회는 세 번째 메달입니다. 사흘 전에 세운 자국 기록을 3초 넘게 갱신했습니다.
items.title_en: Gan Ching Hwee wins Asian Games silver in 800m freestyle
items.title_ko: 간칭웨이, 아시안게임 800미터 자유형 은메달
items.title_original: Gan Ching Hwee claims Asian Games silver in 800m freestyle for third medal in Japan

items.raw_excerpt: Head of Events at Dublin City Council Tony Smithers has said that the capital's Winter Lights programme was always intended to run in December as before, and had been extended to February, after Lord Mayor Daryl Bannon appeared to suggest the illuminations had been moved to January instead.
items.summary_en: Dublin's Winter Lights festival was always meant to run in December. The city council said it was only extended to February. This came after the Lord Mayor suggested the lights had moved to January.
items.summary_ko: 더블린 겨울 조명 행사는 원래 12월에 열리도록 계획되었다. 시|Attracted Someone Like This mean the extension to February is a clarification, not a new schedule.
items.title_en: Dublin Winter Lights Stay in December, Says City Council

items.summary_en: The annual Afpop Expo will be held on October 3 and 4 at the Portimao Arena in Portugal. More benefits for visitors have been added this year. It is a small local show that draws people to the town.

items.summary_en: Taiwan's finance ministry released the winning numbers for the July and August receipt lottery. The special prize number is 89996565. It pays NT$10 million, about US$314,000.

items.raw_excerpt: Pontinha Metro Station, on Lisbon’s Blue Line, is more than a simple place to catch a train.
items.summary_en: Pontinha is a small metro stop on Lisbon's Blue Line. It is more than a place to catch a train. People use it as a meeting point and a small corner of daily life in the neighborhood.

items.raw_excerpt: Its often overlooked for its more famous neighbours, but it offers a completely different experience, in a tranquil setting with views just as beautiful as the tourist towns
items.summary_en: A small fishing village in Cornwall is often missed because of its famous neighbors. It has white washed cottages, thatched roofs and calm views that some visitors like more than the busy tourist towns.

items.raw_excerpt: Com 82 mil moradores, ela subiu 56 posições em um ano e passou uma capital no principal ranking de competitividade das cidades brasileiras
items.summary_en: Eusebio is a small city of about 82,000 people near Fortaleza in northeast Brazil. In one year it jumped 56 places and reached 58th place in a national city competitiveness list of 423 cities. Strong scores in education and telecom helped it pass Recife, which fell to 69th.
items.summary_ko: 포르탈레자 근처의 작은 도시 에우제비우는 인구가 약 8만 2천 명이다. 이 도시는 1년 만에 56계단 올라 전국 423개 도시 가운데 58위에 올랐다. 교육과 통신 항목의 좋은 점수 덕분에 69위로 내려간 레시피를 추월해 북동부에서 경쟁력이 가장 높은 도시가 되었다.
items.title_en: Small City of 82,000 People Passes Recife as Most Competitive in Brazil's Northeast
items.title_ko: 인구 8만 2천명짜리 작은 도시, 레시피를 넘어 북동부 경쟁력 1위
items.title_original: A pequena cidade nordestina de 82 mil moradores que passou Recife e virou a mais competitiva do Nordeste no ranking nacional de 2026 - revistaoeste.com

items.raw_excerpt: Germany is heading into an unusually warm spell that could bring temperatures above 30C in some regions, even as October approaches.
items.summary_en: Germany is heading into an unusually warm spell this weekend. Temperatures could rise above 30C in some regions even though October is just starting.
items.summary_ko: 앞으로 주말 독일에는 평소보다 훨씬 따뜻한 날씨가 이어질 전망이다. 10월이 막 시작되었지만 일부 지역에서는 기온이 30도를 넘을 수 있다.
items.title_en: Germany may see temperatures above 30C this weekend
items.title_ko: 주말 들어선 독일, 기온 30도 넘어설 전망

items.raw_excerpt: The new A69 motorway in south-west France will be a free-flow toll road – but what does that mean, how do you pay, and what are the penalties if you don’t?
items.summary_en: The new A69 motorway in south-west France uses a free-flow toll system. There are no toll booths. Cameras read your plate and you pay online or by phone later. If you do not pay, you can get a fine.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스 남서부에 새로 개통된 아69 고속도로에는 무인차선 요금제가 적용된다. 요금소가 따로 없어 카메라가 차량 번호판을 읽고, 이용자가 나중에 온라인이나 전화로 요금을 낸다. 요금을 내지 않으면 벌금이 부과된다.
items.title_en: Free-Flow Tolls on the New A69 Motorway in South-West France
items.title_ko: 프랑스 남서부 새 아69 고속도로, 무인차선 요금제 도입
items.title_original: How will the toll system work on the new A69 motorway in south western France?

items.raw_excerpt: Earlier this year, Oslo City Council shared plans to merge the city’s 15 districts into 8 larger ones. After a public consultation, city officials have now revealed their final proposed names. Do you agree with the choices?
items.summary_en: Oslo City Council plans to merge the city's 15 districts into 8 bigger ones. After asking the public for opinions, the city has now shared the final proposed names. Residents can still comment on the choices.

items.title_en: What Will Oslo's New Big Districts Be Called?

items.raw_excerpt: Há histórias que parecem ter sido escritas para um filme. A de Casal Novo, na Serra da Lousã, é uma…
items.summary_en: Casal Novo is a tiny schist village in the Lousã mountains of central Portugal. Its story reads like a film script, with a dream the village waited for for a very long time. When the dream finally came true, it was already too late.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 중부 로우산 산에 있는 작은 석재 마을 카살 노보의 이야기다. 마을 사람들은 아주 오랫동안 한 꿈을 기다렸다. 그 꿈이 드디어 이루어졌을 때에는 이미 너무 늦은 뒤였다.
items.title_en: A Small Schist Village's Dream Came Too Late
items.title_ko: 로우산의 작은 석재 마을, 꿈은 너무 늦게 이루어졌다
